claimBoundary: This profile qualifies a package-only complete-input baseline JFIF 4:2:2 JPEG slice: 8-bit SOF0, component IDs 1/2/3, 2x1/1x1/1x1 sampling, one interleaved sequential Huffman scan, 8-bit DQT, optional DRI/RST and no DNL/arithmetic coding.

The decoder owns no frame-sized coefficient or sample surface. Its variable state is one 8-row full-resolution luma strip, one 8-row half-width Cb/Cr strip, two reconstructed full-width chroma rows and 512 bytes of coefficient/quantization/ISLOW scratch, with rows aligned to 64 bytes.

Generated geometry, content, quality and restart cases must match pinned libjpeg-turbo djpeg -rgb -dct int byte-for-byte. Exact operation charge must succeed and charge-1 must fail before output/state allocation.

Passing this profile qualifies only the package-owned baseline 4:2:2 research slice and its resource topology. It does not qualify progressive JPEG, other sampling modes, scaled IDCT, arbitrary color authorities or a default/public production backend.
